target_customer: Industrial buyers such as data center, fab and power plant contractors that need pipe, valves, fittings and fasteners quoted fast
problem: Industrial parts buying runs on slow request for quote email chains with long lead times and certification paperwork.
business_model: Distributor margin on goods sold (inventory and sourcing), with AI used for quoting

founders.name: Berni Hausleitner
founders.background_notes: YC page lists only him; no background given.

technical_complexity.rationale: Quote automation with language models is standard engineering; the hard parts are sourcing, logistics and compliance paperwork, which are operational rather than technical.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier relationships and mill test report handling help a little, but incumbents like large distributors and many regional pipe suppliers sell the same goods.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later coverage says incumbents such as Fastenal and Grainger bought AI assets in 2026, but nothing targeted Westgate in sources.

market_need_then: Strong demand for pipe, valves and fittings is plausible from data center, fab and power builds, but no dated source was gathered; the company's pitch is quotes in about 2 hours.

branding.domain_note: Uses westgatesupply.com, a supply suffix rather than the bare name.

identity.logo: A world mark with uppercase WESTGATE wordmark
identity.visual_style: Industrial and direct; red trucks, American flag icon

rebrands.why: Not stated; the YC page notes the earlier name Soff.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear, plain B2B identity, but the name is generic (a lighting maker and others share it) and no press on the brand was found.

pivots.from: Soff (earlier name, product not described in sources)
pivots.to: Westgate Supply, an AI native industrial distributor

outcome_analysis: Westgate is an active Summer 2024 company that renamed from Soff and now sells industrial piping goods directly. No confirmed funding or revenue was found, so the stage label of Growth from the directory cannot be checked. The outcome is unknown at this point.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with no investors or date; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. Dealroom also mentions a June 2026 partnership with DTG, unverified. A web search did not list Westgate among S24 companies, but the YC page confirms the batch. Competitor searches returned only 2026 coverage, so no dated competitor list is given. Founding year unknown because of the earlier Soff name. Completeness pass: the 125k seed (no date, no investors) rests on a single database (Dealroom); searches found no other source, so the entity match is unconfirmed.
